fix_found: yes | no: a later commit removes or changes a blamed line
fix_is_bugfix: yes | no | unclear: that commit repairs a functional defect (not a refactor, feature change, style or dependency update)
introduced_by_change: yes | no | unclear: the repaired defect was introduced by this change's lines (not pre-existing, not a line the change only touched cosmetically)
decidable_from: diff | file | external | na: what a reviewer would need to see the defect at commit time: the diff alone, the file or repository, or knowledge outside the code (requirements, external APIs, runtime data, later decisions); na if the label is not correct
verdict: correct | wrong | unclear: the change really introduced a functional defect
